text.description_html:
RK International CK-306, Black Porcelain Knob with Polished Chrome Base

There is something so beautiful about the Black Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Chrome Rose. The black porcelain has an old world feel while the chrome brings this cabinet pull straight into the contemporary. This juxtaposition of old and new makes it truly unique and oh-so-stylish. This cabinet knob is available with either a 1 inch diameter or a 1-1/4 inch diameter.

Also Available Matching: Black Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Brass Rose

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-306 Black Porcelain Knob Cabinet:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: Black
  • Base Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Available in 2 Sizes

    RKI-CK-306:
    • Diameter: 1"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"

    RKI-CK-302:
    • Diameter: 1-1/4"
    • Projection: 1-5/8"

Sold Individually
